text: Android: SettingsScreenTest initials-save test is flaky — waitForIdle races the MockWebServer round trip
relates: T-66 (same wait-for-the-wrong-thing test-race family). Confirmed flaky: failed in full verify-all run 2026-07-16, passed in isolated rerun of the class.

Groomed 2026-07-16: bumped p3 -> p2 and should be implemented FIRST — this flake intermittently fails verify-all.sh, which gates verification of every other ticket in this batch (confirmed: failed in the full run, passed in isolation, on the slow sandbox hardware the race window is wide). Fix is fully specified in the body; also sweep the sibling tests in SettingsScreenTest (and other *ScreenTest files using MockWebServer) for the same click -> waitForIdle -> assert-network-result pattern and convert them to waitUntil on the observed state.
